title: Humane Practical Exams
user: An instructor or training provider assessing practical technical skills who wants credible evidence without invasive remote-proctoring surveillance.
smallest_useful_product: Self-hostable web app for a timed task brief, local artifact upload, candidate-written work log, checkpoint hashes, and assessor rubric with an exportable assessment record.
success_measure: Assessors can grade 90% of submissions from the artifact and rubric alone, and fewer than 10% require a surveillance-style follow-up.
constraints: Do not market it as cheat-proof
Encrypt submissions and implement deletion dates
